title: Why Are You So Afraid?
summaryZh: 當信心增長，恐懼就縮小；耶穌能平息罪惡與我們生命中的任何風暴。
lines: As we study the Bible, we learn that the size of our faith impacts the size of our fear.
當我們研讀聖經時，我們學到信心的大小會影響我們恐懼的多寡。
當信心增長，恐懼就縮小。
In Mark chapter four, Jesus and his followers are on a boat and a storm blows through that was wild enough to scare these veterans of the sea.
在馬可福音第四章中，耶穌和跟隨祂的人在一艘船上，突然颳起了一陣風暴，猛烈到足以嚇壞這些海上老手。
They wake up a sleeping Jesus and question Him, asking, “Don't you even care that we're about to drown?”
他們叫醒沉睡的耶穌並質問祂，問道：「我們喪命，你不顧嗎？」
Ever felt like maybe God was unconcerned that your life was or is falling apart?
是否曾覺得神似乎不在乎你的生活正分崩離析？
The loneliness is overwhelming, and God feels, well, asleep.
孤獨感令人窒息，而神感覺起來，嗯，卻在沉睡。
In the story, Jesus wakes up and tells the wind to calm down.
在故事中，耶穌醒來並吩咐風平靜下來。
Then Jesus asks a really important question.
然後耶穌問了一個非常重要的問題。
A question that would be good for you and me to consider in the middle of our storms.
這是一個值得你我在風暴中思考的好問題。
He asks, “Why are you so afraid?
Do you still have no faith?”
See, that storm wasn't even a big one.
你看，那場風暴甚至不算大。
Jesus was about to calm the greatest storm the world had ever known.
耶穌即將平息世界上前所未見的最大風暴。
The cyclone of sin that rages in our lives.
就是在我們生命中肆虐的罪惡狂風。
And if He can calm that storm, what could we possibly be afraid of?
如果祂能平息那場風暴，我們還有什麼好怕的呢？
Are you living in fear today?
Are you stuck in a storm that has you freaking out?
你是否困在讓你嚇壞了的風暴中？
Jesus, who has the power to calm your storm, would say to you, “Come on, why are you so afraid?
有能力平息你的風暴的耶穌會對你說：「來吧，為什麼膽怯？
Do you still have no faith?
There is no storm I can't handle.”
沒有我處理不了的風暴。」
So cry out to Him today and tell Him, “I believe you can calm my storm.
所以今天向祂呼求，並告訴祂：「我相信祢能平息我的風暴。
Tell Him you know He's got you.
告訴祂你知道祂會看顧你。
